steps.text: natures-compass: the compass from slot 0 opens NaturesCompassScreen through Item.use on the client (creative), and the server's SyncPacket carries the biome keys the screen filters

natures-compass: the GUI opens from the local use while the SyncPacket lands a moment later, and tick() rebuilds the list from NaturesCompass.allowedBiomes once after each sync, so this waits for that one rebuild before anything filters

natures-compass: searchTextField = new TransparentTextField(font, 130, 10, 140, 20) added through addRenderableWidget and never focused by init, so one click inside its box focuses it; the biome list itself comes from the level's biome registry, not from terrain
natures-compass: type the pinyin of 平原; processSearchTerm compares BiomeUtils.getBiomeNameForDisplay(level, biome).toLowerCase().contains(typed) per keystroke
